properties.notes: Vacant council-owned buildings within Berwick town centre. The facility formerly providing a learning facility but is now derelict following closure. The site has previously been highlighted as redevelopment opportunity, potentially through conversion. If conversion were not pursued, clearance would be needed prior to redevelopment. Indicative yield previously identified could be at the lower end of range given urban environment, particularly if there is potential for conversion as well as new-build. It has recently been confirmed that this site is no longer available for a housing scheme. No future residential development is now forecast from the site.
